I replied to Dana in our DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **185 seats**. It was signed on 19 Aug 2025.

- **Where it came from:** a 20 Aug 2025 #north-team message in the GBrain notes. Dana first wrote 180, then corrected it to 185 a few minutes later, so I gave 185.
- **What I couldn't check:** the amendment document itself isn't on the shared drive, so I couldn't confirm the number against the contract. I suggested Dana check the signed copy they sent June Osei-Lark if the deck needs to cite the document.
- **Sharing rules:** a seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, and Dana is the account owner, so no approval was needed.
- **Delivery:** sending a direct message to "Dana Okafor" failed because the directory had no member by that name. I posted the reply in this DM conversation (DSHARED0002) instead.
